title: Shared Inbox posts
summary: Durable audience-addressed project work has one shared Done state, with the first completing actor and time. Posts do not expire; posting requires project items.write permission, and completing requires live audience membership plus project read access. Fields are generic key/value data. Compact post cards show project, source and received time together, hide a body repeated by a field, and link email and HTTP(S) values; narrow screens stack labels above values.
